why: Мы постоянно сравниваем: «дешевле», «быстрее», «самый лучший». В русском это одно слово («быстрее»), а в английском форма зависит от длины прилагательного: faster, но more expensive.
formation: • Короткие прилагательные (1 слог): + -er / the + -est. cheap — cheaper — the cheapest.
• Одна гласная + одна согласная: согласная удваивается. big — bigger — the biggest; hot — hotter — the hottest.
• На -y: -y меняется на -ier / -iest. easy — easier — the easiest; busy — busier — the busiest.
• Длинные (2 слога и больше, кроме -y): more + прил. / the most + прил. expensive — more expensive — the most expensive.
• Исключения: good — better — the best; bad — worse — the worst; far — farther (further) — the farthest (furthest).
usage: 1. Сравниваем два предмета: comparative + than. This phone is cheaper than that one. (Этот телефон дешевле того.)

2. Один предмет из группы: the + superlative + in/of. He is the best developer in our team. (Он лучший разработчик в нашей команде.) После in идёт место или группа (in the city, in the class), после of — число или множество (of the three, of all).
3. Равенство: as + прил. + as. My laptop is as fast as yours. (Мой ноутбук такой же быстрый, как твой.) Отрицание: not as + прил. + as. Lviv is not as big as Kyiv. (Львов не такой большой, как Киев.)
4. Меньше, чем: less + прил. + than. This book is less interesting than that one. (Эта книга менее интересна, чем та.)
5. Усиление: much, a lot, far, a bit, slightly + comparative. She is much taller than her sister. (Она намного выше сестры.)
signalWords: than (чем), as ... as (такой же ... как), the ... in/of, much/a bit + comparative.
mistakes: ✗ more cheap → ✓ cheaper. Короткие прилагательные берут -er, а не more.
✗ more better → ✓ better. Better уже сравнительная форма, more лишнее.
✗ the most biggest → ✓ the biggest. Либо -est, либо most, но не оба сразу.
✗ He is taller as me. → ✓ He is taller than me. После сравнительной степени нужен than, а as только в as ... as.
✗ the best of the world → ✓ the best in the world. После superlative с местом или группой ставим in.
✗ This is best restaurant. → ✓ This is the best restaurant. С превосходной степенью нужен the.
remember: Короткое слово: -er и the -est; длинное: more и the most; сравниваем через than, а группу называем через in.

items.prompt: This laptop is ___ (cheap) than that one.
My new phone is ___ (big) than my old one.
Python is ___ (easy) than C++ for beginners.
This hotel is ___ (expensive) than the one near the station.
Today is ___ (hot) than yesterday.
Your English is ___ (good) than before.
The train is ___ (comfortable) than the bus.
My brother is ___ (old) than me.
It's ___ (long) day of the week.
She is ___ (smart) person in our team.
That was ___ (bad) meeting of the year.
Which is ___ (fast) way to the airport?
He is ___ (famous) developer in our city.
It's ___ (busy) street in the town.
This is ___ (good) pizza in the city.
Saturday is ___ (relaxing) day for me.
My flat is (a) more small (b) smaller than yours.
This exercise is (a) easier (b) more easy than the last one.
He is taller (a) than (b) as me.
It's the (a) most big (b) biggest screen in the shop.
The weather today is (a) more good (b) better than yesterday.
She is the best student (a) of (b) in the class.
Your car is as (a) fast (b) faster as mine.
Tom is the (a) youngest (b) most young of the three brothers.
Anna is 25. Tom is 30. Write one sentence with: Anna / young / than Tom.
The red bag costs $50. The blue bag costs $80. Use the word cheap.
items.answer: The red bag is cheaper than the blue bag.

items.prompt: Rewrite with not as ... as: Kyiv is bigger than Lviv.
items.answer: Lviv is not as big as Kyiv. / Lviv isn't as big as Kyiv.

items.prompt: Rewrite with less: This book is more interesting than that one.
items.answer: That book is less interesting than this one.

items.prompt: Rewrite with as ... as: My laptop and your laptop are equally fast.
items.answer: My laptop is as fast as yours. / Your laptop is as fast as mine.

items.prompt: Rewrite with a superlative: No other building in the city is taller than this tower.
items.answer: This tower is the tallest building in the city.

items.prompt: Add the word much: She is taller than her sister.
items.answer: She is much taller than her sister.

items.prompt: The bus takes 40 minutes, the metro takes 25. Use the word fast.
items.answer: The metro is faster than the bus.

items.prompt: Этот ноутбук дороже, чем мой.
items.answer: This laptop is more expensive than mine.

items.prompt: Сегодня холоднее, чем вчера.
items.answer: It's colder today than yesterday. / Today is colder than yesterday.

items.prompt: Это самый лучший ресторан в городе.
items.answer: This is the best restaurant in the city.

items.prompt: Моя работа не такая сложная, как твоя.
items.answer: My job is not as difficult as yours. / My job isn't as hard as yours.

items.prompt: Метро быстрее, чем автобус.
items.answer: The metro is faster than the bus.

items.prompt: Он самый опытный разработчик в нашей команде.
items.answer: He is the most experienced developer in our team.

items.prompt: Этот код намного чище, чем старый.
items.answer: This code is much cleaner than the old one. / This code is much cleaner than the old code.

items.prompt: Это был худший день в моей жизни.
items.answer: That was the worst day of my life. / It was the worst day of my life.
